# Form Factory Games – fitness race in Prague (23 January 2027)

> Form Factory Games is an individual fitness race at Form Factory Vinohradská (Vinohradská 190, Praha 3, Czech Republic) on 23 January 2027: 3 workouts, 4 categories, up to 100 athletes. Organized by STR2G and Form Factory; head organizer Ladislav Suchánek.

## Key facts
- Date: Saturday 23 January 2027 (moved from 5 December 2026), first wave 10:00, results after 17:00
- Venue: Form Factory Vinohradská, Vinohradská 190, 130 00 Praha 3, Czech Republic
- Format: individual race, every athlete does all 3 workouts; scored separately in 4 divisions: Women Open, Women Pro, Men Open, Men Pro
- Capacity: 100 athletes in total, no quotas per division; heats and lanes sent by email after registration closes
